items.question: What is Tucaken?
items.answer: Tucaken turns your real code into a job-tailored, evidence-backed resume. You connect your GitHub account, Tucaken builds a Knowledge Base from your repositories and any resumes you upload, then generates a resume tailored to a specific job description using only the skills it can prove from your actual work.

items.question: How does it work, step by step?
items.answer: 1) Connect your GitHub account and choose which repositories to sync. 2) Tucaken ingests them into your Knowledge Base and extracts a per-skill evidence ledger (verified, partial or gap). 3) Paste a job description. 4) Tucaken generates a tailored resume grounded in your verified evidence. 5) Iterate with gap analysis, an ATS check and interview coaching.

items.question: Do I need to be a developer to use it?
items.answer: Tucaken is built for developers — its core advantage is reading your code to prove your skills. You can also upload an existing resume to enrich your profile, but the strongest results come from connecting repositories.

items.question: Is the GitHub connection read-only?
items.answer: Yes. Tucaken only reads your repositories — it never writes, commits or changes anything in them. Access uses short-lived tokens (valid for one hour) that are never stored.

items.question: What does Tucaken read from my repositories?
items.answer: Repository code and metadata (names, branches, last-updated), used to build your Knowledge Base and extract skill evidence.

items.question: Can I choose which repositories are used?
items.answer: Yes. After connecting, you pick exactly which repositories to sync. You can connect public and private repositories you have access to.

items.question: Will it modify my code or open pull requests?
items.answer: No. The connection is strictly read-only.

items.question: How many plans are there?
items.answer: Three: Free, Pro and Premium. Free lets you connect one repository, run up to three syncs a month and generate one tailored resume per month, with PDF and web export. Pro and Premium lift those limits to unlimited and add a custom domain on web resumes and priority support; Premium additionally runs deep AI enrichment on repository sync. Current prices are shown on the pricing page.

items.question: Is there a free plan?
items.answer: Yes — Free lets you connect one repository and generate one tailored resume per month, with PDF and web export. No card required.

items.question: How much does Tucaken cost?
items.answer: Free is €0. Pro and Premium are paid monthly subscriptions — see the pricing page for current amounts. (Prices to be confirmed before launch.)

items.question: Is there a trial?
items.answer: To be confirmed: state what the trial unlocks and for how long before launch.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes. You cancel from the billing portal; your subscription stays active until the end of the current billing period, then automatically reverts to Free. You keep paid features until that date.

items.question: Can I undo a cancellation?
items.answer: Yes — you can resume a cancelled subscription any time before the period ends, and nothing changes.

items.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade?
items.answer: Yes, from the billing portal, where you can also update your payment method and view invoices.

items.question: Do I get a refund if I cancel?
items.answer: Cancellation takes effect at the end of your billing period rather than immediately. To be confirmed: state your refund policy before launch.

items.question: How are payments handled?
items.answer: Securely through Stripe. Tucaken never sees or stores your card details.

items.question: What data does Tucaken store?
items.answer: Your profile (name, email, avatar), the repositories you sync, resumes you upload, extracted career entries and your skill-evidence ledger, plus your plan and billing status.

items.question: Is my code or resume shared with anyone or used to train models?
items.answer: No. Your uploaded resumes and indexed code are used only to build your Knowledge Base and tailor your resumes. There is no secondary use, sharing or selling.

items.question: Can I delete my account?
items.answer: Yes. Deleting your account cancels any active subscription immediately, disables sign-in and removes your access. To be confirmed: your data-retention wording (records are retained for audit and compliance rather than instantly purged).

items.question: Where is my data processed?
items.answer: The AI pipeline runs on AWS in the EU region. To be confirmed: the exact region and residency statement you want to publish.

items.question: How do I sign in?
items.answer: With email and password, or via Google or GitHub. Sign-in is handled securely through AWS Cognito.

items.question: Do I sign in with GitHub and connect GitHub separately?
items.answer: You can sign in with GitHub, and you separately authorise repository access for the Knowledge Base — these are two distinct steps.

items.question: What AI powers Tucaken?
items.answer: A multi-agent pipeline built on Anthropic's Claude models (via AWS Bedrock) reads your code and job description, verifies your skills against evidence, and writes the tailored resume.

items.question: Why does Tucaken only use proven skills?
items.answer: To keep your resume honest and defensible. Each claim is backed by evidence from your code, documented projects or career history — so you can stand behind every line in an interview.

items.question: What do I actually get out?
items.answer: A tailored resume (PDF and web), a gap-analysis report (verified, partial or gap per skill), an ATS keyword check, job-match insight, and stage-based interview coaching.

items.question: What can I upload?
items.answer: You can import an existing resume to enrich your profile. To be confirmed: the accepted file formats (for example PDF) for the published answer.
